prompt: A massive dragon caught mid-LEAP, like a cat pouncing on prey. THE POSE: front half raised high (head at MAX Y), back half lower with hind legs pushing off the ground, body in a tight diagonal angle from low-rear to high-front. CRITICAL: front legs/claws thrust FORWARD AND DOWN as if grabbing prey, NOT extended sideways. Wings spread WIDE for catching air during the leap (not folded). Tail trailing low behind. Head LOW and forward, jaws wide open showing teeth, neck stretched. The whole creature should read like it's diving at the camera from above-and-behind. Build mostly with BRICK for red scales, STONE for darker chest/wing-membrane shading, OAK_LOG for horns and clawtips, SAND for belly highlights. The silhouette should look like a leaping pose from the side — front high, back low, wings out.
